## What does this change teach the agent?

Describe the industrial problem, workflow, correction, or new capability.

## Why is this reusable?

Explain why the behavior applies beyond one specific machine, customer, or project.

## Validation

How was the change tested, reviewed, or otherwise validated?

## Public sources

For vendor-specific claims, link public product documentation, manuals, API docs, release notes, public vendor repositories, or other intentionally public sources.

## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the change for customer-confidential or identifying information.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, secrets, real site IP addresses/hostnames, proprietary project files, private process data, or internal-only vendor documentation.
- [ ] Vendor-specific claims are backed by public sources where practical.
- [ ] Examples use generic names, tags, addresses, and process values.
- [ ] The change teaches actionable agent behavior, not only background theory.
- [ ] The core skill remains vendor-neutral unless this change is intentionally inside a vendor reference.
- [ ] I did not turn one installation-specific observation into a universal product rule.
